# Design System: Smart Drive Video (智驾影音)

**Version:** 1.0
**Theme:** Automotive / Dark Mode / Tech
**Generated by:** UI/UX Pro Max Intelligence

## 1. Design Principles (设计原则)

Based on the automotive context and `ui-ux-pro-max` guidelines, the design prioritizes **Safety**, **Clarity**, and **Efficiency**.

*   **Safety First (安全优先)**: High contrast, large touch targets (>44px), and minimal distraction. The interface must be legible at a glance.
*   **Dark Mode Native (深色原生)**: Default to dark mode to reduce glare during night driving and match the automotive cockpit aesthetic.
*   **Efficiency (高效操作)**: Minimize steps for core actions (export, preview).

## 2. Color Palette (色彩体系)

### Primary Colors (主色)
Used for primary actions (buttons, active states, highlights).

*   **Brand Blue**: `#3B82F6` (Blue-500) - Clear, trustworthy, standard tech color.
*   **Active State**: `#2563EB` (Blue-600) - Hover/Pressed state.

### Neutral Colors (中性色 - Dark Mode)
Used for backgrounds, surfaces, and text.

*   **Background**: `#0F172A` (Slate-900) - Deep blue-black, better than pure black for OLED/LCD.
*   **Surface (Card)**: `#1E293B` (Slate-800) - Slightly lighter for hierarchy.
*   **Surface (Elevated)**: `#334155` (Slate-700) - Modals, dropdowns.
*   **Border**: `#475569` (Slate-600) - Subtle dividers.

### Text Colors (文本色)
*   **Primary Text**: `#F8FAFC` (Slate-50) - High legibility (Contrast > 15:1).
*   **Secondary Text**: `#94A3B8` (Slate-400) - Metadata, timestamps.
*   **Disabled/Placeholder**: `#64748B` (Slate-500).

### Semantic Colors (语义色)
*   **Success**: `#10B981` (Emerald-500) - Export complete.
*   **Warning**: `#F59E0B` (Amber-500) - Low storage, overwriting.
*   **Error**: `#EF4444` (Red-500) - Export failed, file missing.

## 3. Typography (字体排印)

Using system fonts for native feel and performance.

*   **Font Stack**: `HarmonyOS Sans`, `Roboto`, `San Francisco`, `sans-serif`.
*   **Base Size**: 16px (Minimum for legibility).

| Style | Size | Weight | Line Height | Usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Heading 1** | 24px | Bold (700) | 32px | Screen Titles |
| **Heading 2** | 20px | SemiBold (600) | 28px | Section Headers |
| **Body** | 16px | Regular (400) | 24px | Main Content, Lists |
| **Caption** | 14px | Regular (400) | 20px | Timestamps, Metadata |
| **Small** | 12px | Regular (400) | 16px | Tags, Badges |

## 4. Layout & Spacing (布局与间距)

*   **Grid System**: 4px base unit. Common spacers: 4, 8, 16, 24, 32px.
*   **Margins**:
    *   Screen Edge: 16px (Mobile standard).
    *   Section Spacing: 24px.
    *   Item Spacing: 12px.
*   **Touch Targets**: Minimum **44x44px** (or 48x48px for better car UX) for all interactive elements.

## 5. UI Components (组件规范)

### Cards (行程卡片)
*   **Background**: Slate-800 (`#1E293B`).
*   **Border Radius**: 12px.
*   **Padding**: 16px.
*   **Shadow**: `shadow-md` (0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)).
*   **Content**: Date (Bold), Time Range (Secondary), Camera Icons (Badges).

### Buttons (按钮)
*   **Primary**: Brand Blue background, White text, Full width or fixed height (48px). Rounded-lg.
*   **Secondary**: Transparent background, Border Slate-600, White text.
*   **Icon Button**: 44x44px hit area, 24px icon size.

#### Button States (交互状态)
*   **Normal**: Default state.
*   **Hover/Focus**: Brightness +10% or Border Highlight (for car knob navigation).
*   **Pressed/Active**: Scale 95% + Brightness -10%. Immediate visual feedback.
*   **Disabled**: Opacity 50%, grayscale, cursor-not-allowed. No interaction.
*   **Loading**: Show spinner, text hidden/dimmed, click disabled.

### Timeline (多轨时间轴)
*   **Track Height**: 40px per camera track.
*   **Cursor**: Vertical line (Brand Blue), draggable.
*   **Clip Representation**: Rounded rects in Slate-700.
*   **Selected Clip**: Border 2px Brand Blue (`#3B82F6`).

### Orientation & Layout (横竖屏适配)

#### Portrait Mode (竖屏 - Default)
*   **Use Case**: Quick browsing, single-hand operation, list view.
*   **Layout**:
    *   **Top (35%)**: Preview Player.
    *   **Bottom (65%)**: Scrollable Trip List or Control Panel.

#### Landscape Mode (横屏 - Critical for Editing)
*   **Use Case**: Fine-tuning, full-screen preview, timeline editing, car screen projection.
*   **Layout**:
    *   **Left (60%)**: Large Preview Player (16:9).
    *   **Right (40%)**: Expanded Multi-Track Timeline + Edit Tools.
    *   **Navigation**: Sidebar collapses to icon-only rail.
*   **Behavior**:
    *   **Auto-Rotate**: Player expands to fill available height.
    *   **Timeline**: Tracks expand horizontally for precise seeking.

### Icons (图标)
*   **Style**: Outline or Filled (consistent).
*   **Source**: Heroicons / Lucide React (SVG).
*   **Size**: 24px default.
*   **NO Emojis**: Use professional SVG icons for UI elements.

## 6. Accessibility (无障碍)

*   **Contrast**: All text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) standards.
*   **Focus States**: Visible ring for keyboard/remote control navigation.
*   **Labels**: All icon-only buttons must have `aria-label`.

## 7. Implementation Guidelines (Tech Stack)

*   **Framework**: React Native / Flutter / HarmonyOS ArkUI (Native).
*   **Styling**: Tailwind CSS (if Web/RN) or Native Styles.
*   **Assets**: SVG for icons, PNG/WebP for static images.
